lighting.note: Level is not an activation percentage and not EMG. Within the measured band it is this group's share of the largest joint moment measured in this one session; every muscle in a group shares its level, because the measurement is of the joint and cannot tell them apart. Reference structures are all one level: they show where to look, not how much.

notice: Every value carries a tier. 'measured' came from this person's video in this session. 'reference' is anatomy: it says where to look, not what was observed. Nothing here measured a nerve, a bone's load, or anything about a brain.
